Michael hears about her happy childhood and how she later found sanctuary there, when King Edward VIII abdicated and she and Prince Albert unexpectedly became king and queen of the United Kingdom

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is at Elgin's port, the coastal town of Lossiemouth, where the Labour Party's first prime minister James Ramsay MacDonald was born. Nearby, Michael finds a remote boarding school established in the 1930s and famous today both for its unusual ideas and its royal former pupils. His penultimate stop is Inverness, where he uncovers the work of female photographer MEM Donaldson, who documented a Highland way of life that was rapidly disappearing. Michael's journey ends at Loch Ness, where he joins a Deep Scan research team scouring the deep for signs of the elusive monster

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the West Country between the wars, setting off from the Cornish seaside resort of St Ives and ending his first in the former mining village of St Day. He visits Britain's first studio pottery, where he attempts a decorative wax technique and feels the heat of the firing kiln. Michael also joins a family on holiday in a railway carriage called Harvey

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Cornwall's county town, Truro, heading to the historic estate of Trewithen, whose gardens were stocked from China by professional plant hunters commissioned by its owner. The Atlantic Coast branch line carries Michael north to Newquay, where he discovers a pioneering surfer and braves the waves on a belly board. In the nearby village of St Mawgan, Michael is introduced to the ancient Cornish sport of 'wrassling', which surged in popularity between the wars as part of a Cornish Celtic revival

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo reaches Bodmin en route to Totnes, as he explores the West Country from St Ives to Salisbury Plain. Out on the rugged moor, Michael hears how the celebrated author Daphne du Maurier captivated readers between the wars with her tales of smuggling at the Jamaica Inn. In Devon, Michael takes the plunge at Plymouth's beautiful art deco Tinside Lido, while at Ivybridge, he boards a vehicle like no other to cross the causeway to Burgh Island, where a 1930s playboy built a splendid art deco party palace

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's exploration of the West Country continues in south Devon. He arrives in Paignton to investigate an extraordinarily high murder rate in the literature of the 1930s. The Dartmouth Steam Railway conveys him in style to the beautiful home of Agatha Christie, in the company of her great-grandson, James Prichard

programme.desc: The unlikely alliances that Zambia's wild animals sometimes form when protecting their young, finding food and beating predators

She starts the timer, and everyone hurries off to their nap stations to begin their naps. As the other Fluffytowners start to doze off, Love Monster struggles to fall asleep. As everyone boogies to the beats, Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny looks over to the decks, but Love Monster is nowhere to be seen. programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.sub-title: East Lothian - Saving the Musselburgh Carriage
programme.desc: [AD] Will Kirk and Kirsten Ramsay head to Musselburgh, on Scotland's east coast. It's a town boasting a proud heritage that is celebrated each year with a procession led by their elected Honest Lad and Honest Lass. However, for the past few years, the antique carriage these local luminaries ride in has been off the road. Restoring the carriage is a huge job that requires the skills of local signwriter Ross Hastie and wheelwright Greg Rowland, and made more complicated by the impending deadline of this year's festival. A musical instrument also needs some tender loving care and Will gets a makeover at Scotland's oldest bespoke tailors

programme.desc: A gang of streetwise penguins decides to escape from New York's Central Park Zoo and return to a life in the wild, but when Marty the zebra and his friends follow suit, they end up stranded in Africa on a jungle island without a clue about how to fend for themselves. Animated comedy, with the voices of Ben Stiller, David Schwimmer, Chris Rock, Jada Pinkett Smith and Sacha Baron Cohen

programme.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
programme.desc: The escaped zoo animals discover a plane and, following a swift repair job by the penguins, manage to escape the desolate shores of Madagascar. However, they crash-land on the plains of Africa and find themselves face-to-face with their wild counterparts for the first time. Animated comedy sequel, with the voices of Ben Stiller, Chris Rock, David Schwimmer and Jada Pinkett Smith

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton

programme.title: Planes
programme.desc: A crop duster longs to be a racing plane, but is hamstrung by a fear of heights. With the aid of a veteran flyer, he learns to conquer his phobia and compete against some of the world's greatest flyers in a round-the-world race. Animated adventure spin-off from Pixar's Cars, with the voices of Dane Cook, Teri Hatcher and Stacy Keach

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: [AD] An ageing assassin is targeted by a mysterious young operative that seems able to anticipate his every move. Discovering that he's being hunted by a younger clone of himself, Henry needs to find out why he's being targeted and who the creator is. Action drama, starring Will Smith, Mary Elizabeth Winstead and Clive Owen

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Extreme sports star Xander Cage finds himself in trouble when his daredevil exploits land him behind bars. However, he is offered an intriguing escape route, courtesy of National Security Agent Augustus Gibbons - who thinks the adrenaline junkie is the perfect man to bring down a gang of international terrorists in Prague. Action adventure, starring Vin Diesel, Samuel L Jackson, Asia Argento, Marton Csokas and Michael Roof

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Creepy couple Morticia and Gomez find their unconventional life threatened by a man claiming to be a long-lost relative. When they welcome him with open arms, they fall prey to a plot that could cost them their ancestral home and the family fortune. Black comedy based on the 1960s TV series, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia, Christopher Lloyd, Christina Ricci, Jimmy Workman and Carel Struycken

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: Spooky couple Gomez and Morticia hire a nanny to look after their new baby son - and stop him suffering an early death at the hands of his jealous elder siblings. Romance soon blossoms between the new childminder and Uncle Fester, but he does not realise she is planning to kill him once she has got hold of the family fortune. Comedy sequel, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia, Christopher Lloyd, Christina Ricci and Joan Cusack

programme.title: E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: [AD] A lonely boy befriends an alien who has been left stranded on Earth. The two develop a psychic connection as the boy helps the extraterrestrial to contact his own people and call for rescue. However, living on Earth starts to have a devastating effect on the visitor's health, and a government operative is determined to capture him for study. Steven Spielberg's sci-fi fantasy, starring Henry Thomas, Drew Barrymore, Dee Wallace and Peter Coyote

programme.title: Logan Lucky
programme.desc: Two brothers plan to pull off an ambitious heist during a Nascar race in North Carolina, but first they need the help of a convicted safe-cracker - who is currently doing time in prison. Steven Soderberg's crime caper, starring Channing Tatum, Adam Driver, Daniel Craig and Riley Keough

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: A former member of a singing trio, now running a hotel on a Greek island, is reunited with her old bandmates for her daughter's wedding - but is surprised when three of her old flames also show up unexpectedly. The three men have been invited by the bride, who wants to find out which one of them is her father. Musical comedy, with a soundtrack of Abba songs, starring Meryl Streep, Pierce Brosnan, Julie Walters, Colin Firth, Stellan Skarsgard and Amanda Seyfried

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: [AD] A Soviet submarine commander creates an international crisis by piloting his experimental nuclear vessel, which is invisible to sonar, toward the American coast. The US and Russian navies think he is planning to attack and set out to destroy the submarine, but a CIA analyst suspects he intends to defect to the West. Cold War thriller, based on Tom Clancy's novel, starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and James Earl Jones

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: A fishing boat crew plucks a man out of the sea with two bullet wounds in his back and a safety-deposit number sewn into his skin - but absolutely no memory of who he is or how he got there. In the search for his true identity, he is pursued by assassins - but his skill at evading them suggests his own past is far from straightforward. Thriller, starring Matt Damon, Franka Potente, Chris Cooper, Clive Owen and Brian Cox

programme.title: Ferrari
programme.desc: [AD] During the summer of 1957, ex-racecar driver Enzo Ferrari is in crisis. Bankruptcy stalks the company he and his wife, Laura, built from nothing a decade earlier. Their tempestuous marriage struggles with the mourning for one son and the acknowledgement of another. Attempting to secure their survival, he rolls the dice on one race - 1,000 miles across Italy, the iconic Mille Miglia. Director Michael Mann's drama, starring Adam Driver and Jack O'Connell

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: A farmer is murdered by a hired hand, who flees into the wilderness. The dead man's strong-willed 14-year-old daughter is determined to bring the killer to justice, and recruits the aid of a hard-drinking, one-eyed marshal to help her track him down. The Coen brothers' Western based on Charles Portis' novel, with Jeff Bridges, Hailee Steinfeld, Matt Damon and Josh Brolin

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Film-makers venture deep into the Amazon jungle to document the lives of a remote tribe. However, the expedition is hijacked by a crazed hunter who plans to use them as bait to catch a gigantic killer snake. Adventure, starring Jennifer Lopez, Jon Voight, Ice Cube, Eric Stoltz and Jonathan Hyde

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: The world is thrown into uproar when 12 alien spaceships arrive at locations around the globe. As tensions rise between nations and fear of the arrivals grows, a recently bereaved linguist is recruited by the US army to find a way to communicate with the aliens and discover why they have come. Sci-fi drama, starring Amy Adams, Jeremy Renner and Forest Whitaker

programme.title: Star Trek Beyond
programme.desc: [AD] The USS Enterprise sets out on a rescue mission which turns out to be a deadly trap set by a mysterious warlord. The crew are left stranded on an unexplored planet, and join forces with a fugitive alien scavenger to find a way off the hostile world and prevent a terrible weapon being unleashed upon the galaxy. Sci-fi adventure, starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto and Idris Elba

programme.sub-title: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery

programme.desc: [AD] The Harpers are looking forward to another Christmas - except for Scrooge-like dad Ben, who this year comes up with a cunning plan, feigning a mystery illness to escape the festivities. Susan is unconvinced, but nonetheless drags him to the doctor, who admits the grumpy dentist to hospital. With him out of the way, son Michael and lodger Alfie organise a last-minute party, while Janey is too busy trying to get the must-have toy for Kenzo, whether he wants it or not. programme.desc: A Nascar racing champion has everything he could want - until an arrogant French rival seizes the title from him, and his wife runs off with his best friend. Forced to move back in with his mother, the downhearted driver turns to his estranged father for help rebuilding his shattered self-confidence. Comedy, starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Amnesiac rogue assassin Jason Bourne's long-buried memories are reawakened by a British journalist researching the secret organisation that was responsible for transforming him into a killing machine. Meanwhile, a ruthless CIA director becomes convinced Bourne is still a security risk, and plans to dispose of him once and for all. Third instalment of the spy thriller series, directed by Paul Greengrass and starring Matt Damon, Joan Allen, Julia Stiles, David Strathairn, Paddy Considine, Scott Glenn and Albert Finney

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.sub-title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: [AD] Bruno, a boy in Nazi Germany, moves to the country when his father is placed in charge of a concentration camp. While exploring the woods close to the facility's boundary, he spots a Jewish youngster being held there, and the two become friends - but Bruno remains innocently oblivious to the camp's true purpose. Drama, starring David Thewlis, Asa Butterfield and Jack Scanlon

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Murderous alien beasties escape from their space prison and flee to Earth, where they wreak havoc in a sleepy Kansas village as they discover the delights of snacking on human flesh - and only two intergalactic bounty hunters look capable of saving the day. Madcap horror comedy, starring Dee Wallace Stone, M Emmet Walsh, Billy Green Bush and Scott Grimes

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: In the future, environmental disasters have left the planet flooded. A web-footed mutant mariner helps a woman and an orphan girl search for a mythical haven of dry land, with the help of a map tattooed on the child's back - but in the process has to fend off a villainous crew of nicotine-addicted pirates. Sci-fi adventure, starring Kevin Costner, Dennis Hopper, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Tina Majorino and Rick Aviles

programme.title: Come Dine with Me

Alliances are quickly forged when David and Tina discover they both love a good gossip, before they turn their attention to Stephen when David compares him to a tramp. Julie overcooks her beef, but will her hosting make up for it and bag her the £1,000 prize?

programme.title: Why Sinkholes Collapse
programme.desc: [AD] On 24 September 2025, a massive sinkhole opened outside a Bangkok hospital, swallowing vehicles, damaging infrastructure and forcing nearly 1,000 people to evacuate. This film investigates its causes, exploring how collapsing tunnels, ageing sewers, abandoned mines, groundwater depletion and urban development contribute to the growing global threat of city sinkholes

programme.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
programme.desc: [AD] The historian uncovers the untold stories of incredible palaces and the people who lived there, beginning by travelling to Venice, where she is given the keys to the Doge's Palace, a multi-purpose building that controlled Venice's empire for a thousand years. programme.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? Celebrity Special

Animated comedy, with the voices of James McAvoy, Jim Broadbent and Bill Nighy

programme.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
programme.desc: The plucky sea creature sets out to prove his boss Mr Krabs is innocent of stealing Neptune's crown. However, the missing item has ended up in sinister Shell City, which all sea-dwellers fear and from which few have ever returned. Animated comedy, with the voices of Tom Kenny, Bill Fagerbakke, Clancy Brown and Scarlett Johansson, plus a cameo appearance by David Hasselhoff

programme.title: The Secret Life of Pets 2
programme.desc: [AD] Max the terrier encounters canine-intolerant cows, hostile foxes and a scary turkey when he visits the countryside. Luckily for the lovable dog, he soon catches a break when he meets Rooster, a gruff farm dog who tries to cure the pooch of his neuroses. Animated sequel, featuring the voices of Patton Oswalt, Kevin Hart and Harrison Ford

programme.title: Dr Seuss' The Lorax
programme.desc: A boy leaves his urban home in search of a real tree, and meets the reclusive industrialist who first created the city. The hermit tells the story of a grumpy forest creature who tried to stop him destroying the trees, and inspires the youngster to undo the damage that has been done. Animated fantasy based on the children's book, with the voices of Danny DeVito, Zac Efron and Ed Helms

programme.title: Monsters vs Aliens
programme.desc: A woman is exposed to radiation from a meteorite that causes her to grow to an enormous size during her wedding. She is captured by the military and held prisoner with an assortment of strange creatures - but when aliens invade, these freaks of nature are the only ones capable of saving the world. Animated sci-fi comedy, with the voices of Reese Witherspoon and Hugh Laurie

programme.title: Wish
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Asha makes a wish on a star to save her kingdom from rising evil and her plea is answered by a celestial body with the power to grant further desires. Animated fantasy featuring the voice of Arianna DeBose

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: A deformed bell-ringer living reclusively in a cathedral in the heart of medieval Paris is tempted out of seclusion when a gypsy festival arrives and captures his imagination. Here in the outside world, he learns the cruel government minister who raised him is hatching a plan to wipe out the gypsies, so he resolves to protect his new friends. Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: [AD] Married explorers Rick and Evelyn battle the newly resurrected mummy Imhotep and his ruthless partner, who have captured their son. The undead creature is heading for a confrontation with a legendary ancient warrior - with power over a magical army to be won. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Brendan Fraser, Rachel Weisz, John Hannah, Arnold Vosloo, Oded Fehr and Patricia Velasquez, with a brief appearance by Dwayne Johnson

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: A ruthless warlord resolves to rid the desert of its few remaining tribes, prompting them to seek the help of a legendary assassin to end the despot's reign of terror by destroying his source of power - a beautiful but deadly sorceress. Fantasy action adventure, starring Dwayne Johnson, Steven Brand, Kelly Hu and Michael Clarke Duncan

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: A crooked railway tycoon whose men are terrorising a frontier town arranges for a black sheriff to be appointed, hoping the racist residents will reject him. The lawman proves more cunning than expected, and with the help of a drunken gunslinger, runs rings around the businessman. Mel Brooks' Western spoof, in which he co-stars alongside Cleavon Little, Gene Wilder and Madeline Kahn

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: Trainee crew members of the starship Enterprise embark on their maiden flight, which pits them against a Romulan commander from the future who is planning a horrific revenge on those he blames for a tragedy in his own time. Sci-fi adventure based on the original TV series, starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto, Eric Bana, Zoe Saldana and Leonard Nimoy

programme.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
programme.desc: [AD] Captain Kirk and the crew of the starship Enterprise are sent on a clandestine mission into enemy territory to track down the rogue Starfleet agent behind a terrorist attack on Earth. However, the assignment brings to light a hidden threat from within their own organisation. Sci-fi adventure sequel, starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto and Benedict Cumberbatch

programme.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
programme.desc: [AD] Arrogant newsreader Ron Burgundy's career is rescued from a drunken slump by an executive for a new 24-hour news channel. Reassembling his team of sidekicks, he swiftly rises from the network's graveyard to become its biggest star with a run of ludicrously sensationalist broadcasts. Comedy sequel, starring Will Ferrell, Christina Applegate, Paul Rudd and Steve Carell

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: A former member of a singing trio, now running a hotel on a Greek island, is reunited with her old bandmates for her daughter's wedding - but is surprised when three of her old flames also show up unexpectedly. The three men have been invited by the bride, who wants to find out which one of them is her father. Musical comedy, with a soundtrack of Abba songs, starring Meryl Streep, Pierce Brosnan, Julie Walters, Colin Firth, Stellan Skarsgard and Amanda Seyfried

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: A group of rogue police officers responds to a complaint with apparent retribution rather than justice in mind, launching a raid on a group of African-Americans. Public anger reaches a peak after the incident, as relationships sour with authority. Fact-based drama set during the 1967 Detroit riots, starring John Boyega, Anthony Mackie and Algee Smith

programme.title: Black Bag
programme.desc: [AD] When a spy is suspected of treason, her husband faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country. Director Steven Soderbergh's thriller, starring Michael Fassbender, Cate Blanchett and Rege-Jean Page

programme.title: Philadelphia
programme.desc: [AD] A gay lawyer is fired after contracting Aids, and takes his former employers to court to prove he was discriminated against because of his condition. The only attorney he can find to represent him is a homophobic courtroom rival, who is forced to confront his prejudices as the case unfolds and his client's health deteriorates. Drama, starring an Oscar-winning Tom Hanks, with Denzel Washington and Antonio Banderas

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: A 1960s singing trio are chosen to perform backing vocals for a popular performer - an event that launches the band on a successful career of their own. However, when the most attractive of the girls is picked as the face of the group, edging out the other two, personal rivalries begin to jeopardise their friendship. Musical drama, inspired by the rise to fame of Diana Ross and the Supremes, and starring Jamie Foxx, Beyonce Knowles, Eddie Murphy and an Oscar-winning Jennifer Hudson

programme.title: Innerspace
programme.desc: A Navy test pilot is shrunk in a ground-breaking scientific experiment, but instead of being injected into a laboratory rabbit, the tiny specimen accidentally winds up inside a hypochondriac supermarket worker. As he tries to find a way out, criminals come after the unlikely duo in search of the secret of the miniaturising technology. Sci-fi comedy, starring Dennis Quaid, Martin Short, Meg Ryan, Kevin McCarthy, Fiona Lewis and Vernon Wells

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Love Monster, Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny and Bad Idea Puppy arrive at Elder Kitten's house with a cart full of decorating things. It's Makeover Day, and they want to make over Elder Kitten's living room while he gets a relaxing makeover himself at the Fluffytown spa. When they finish, Love Monster thinks it's very different from Elder Kitten's usual style. He starts to wonder whether Elder Kitten will be good surprised or bad surprised. Just then, Elder Kitten returns from his spa day. Bad Idea Puppy and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny show him his new living room and explain that they decorated with the best bright things they could think of. As Elder Kitten looks on a little unsure, Love Monster asks him whether he loves it. Elder Kitten is a little lost for words and, not wanting to hurt their feelings, he simply agrees with them that it's bright and very different. Love Monster can tell that Elder Kitten doesn't like it, and eventually Elder Kitten gently admits that it's not really his style. The friends realise that they got so excited that they just did the makeover how they would like it but not how Elder Kitten would like it. They apologise, but Elder Kitten says it's okay and gives them a hug. Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny asks how they can make it up to him, and Elder Kitten suggests that they make over their makeover in his favourite paint colour. As they get to work, Elder Kitten spots one of their paw prints in paint on the floor covers and has an idea. Later, the room is decorated but with a border of colourful paw prints around the middle. Now he'll always think of his favourite bright things even when they're not there. Sometimes, the brightest surprises are best when you think of your friends.

Comedy, with Matthew Perry, Bruce Willis, Rosanna Arquette and Michael Clarke Duncan

programme.title: What the Killer Did Next

programme.title: Planet Weird

There was no trace of a murder weapon in the property where the victim lived alone - but despite the shortage of clues, the local rumour mill soon revealed more about the victim and the name of a possible suspect

programme.title: Mahadev & Sons

programme.title: Dr. Aarambhi

programme.title: Shayad Yahi Hai Pyaar

programme.title: Yaariyan 2

programme.title: Jolly LLB

programme.title: Dilo Ki Ram Leela
programme.desc: A wealthy woman enters an arranged marriage hoping to win her father's affection. As family tensions rise, she unexpectedly discovers love and a new purpose.

programme.title: Match of the Day Wales Live
programme.desc: Wales v Norway (Kick-off 7.15pm). Coverage of the first leg of the FIFA Women's World Cup play-off final, held at Cardiff City Stadium. Wales defeated Albania 4-0 on aggregate in the semi-finals and are now looking to qualify for the finals for the first time in their history. However, they face a stern test against the Norwegians, who comfortably overcame Romania 8-0 over two legs in the previous round and have qualified for every previous World Cup, winning the second staging of the tournament back in 1995

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Go West
programme.desc: [AD] Dave and Si explore the region around the River Severn, an area famous for its fusion of flavours and meet locals with their own special recipes. They visit a street food stall known as Babhaus, which brings a Mexican fusion menu to Newport and Netherend Farm in Gloucestershire where they meet Wyndham and Linda, who have developed a new product, nutty clarified butter Ghee. In the town of Tewkesbury they discover Samantha, who creates mustard balls, which the boys learn how to make the traditional way

programme.title: The Story So Far: The Best of
programme.desc: The best of Ali Plumb's Story So Far programmes. Part 4

programme.title: Live Snooker: UK Championship
programme.desc: Coverage of the evening session on day four at York Barbican, featuring the concluding two first-round matches, played over the best of 11 frames. Three-time champion John Higgins is in action on table one, and will hope to make a deep run this year, having not progressed beyond the quarter-finals since he last won the tournament in 2010. On the other table, Xiao Guodong will be looking to progress to the second round for the first time since 2021, having lost 6-2 to Pang Junxu at this stage last year. Abigail Davies presents, with commentary and analysis from Steve Davis, John Parrott, Ken Doherty, Joe Perry, Steven Hallworth and Stephen Hendry

programme.title: Stacey & Joe: In Too Deep
programme.sub-title: Home Is Where Your Family Is
programme.desc: [AD] With just a few days to go before Stacey and Joe welcome friends and family to the lake, the pressure is on to get everything finished. But before the final push begins, there's an emotional goodbye as Stacey takes Zach to the airport for his journey to America. But back home, Joe cheers her up with an unlikely upcycling project. Family and friends then arrive to see the hard work Joe and Stacey have put into the lake - but the morning after, they pack the car and say goodbye to Pickle Cottage

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: [AD] Knockout week begins, with the 12 remaining chefs facing their toughest test yet as seafood maestro Paul Ainsworth challenges them to reinvent one of Britain's best-loved dishes - fish and chips. But a classic simply won't cut it. Paul wants culinary brilliance, daring innovation and a dish that will blow his mind. Those who perform strongest will secure a place in the semi-finals, while the four worst are forced into a second challenge that turns the rules of cooking on its head. With the hobs and ovens switched off, the contestants must create an exceptional dish using only raw ingredients

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.sub-title: Lost on the Cape Wrath Trail
programme.desc: [AD] Police mountain rescue officers search for a 76-year-old walker who has been missing for days during terrible weather in one of the Highlands' most remote areas. In Stornoway, officers try to calm a dispute between relatives exchanging violent threats, while police in Nairn deal with a bust-up on a bus that threatens to turn violent

programme.title: QI XL
programme.desc: Sandi Toksvig hosts and extended version of the quiz, looking for the X factor with Kiri Pritchard-McLean, Daniel Sloss, La Voix and Alan Davies

programme.title: Pointless Celebrities
programme.desc: Alexander Armstrong and Richard Osman present as radio presenters Fee Mak, DJ Spoony, Matt Chorley, Mariella Frostrup, Zoe Hardman, Ali Plumb, Johnny Cochrane and Inel Tomlinson try to come up with the least likely correct answers to a series of questions posed to members of the public

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: [AD] Tom leaves Cain powerless, Kev opens a food truck outside the Woolpack and Caleb rejects Sadie's advances

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: [AD] Shona follows a clue to Jodie and Lily's location, Carla pressures Brody to betray Idris, Christina settles Lucy into her new home, and Jake's antics dismay Maria and Izzy

programme.title: I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here!
programme.desc: Ant and Dec guide viewers through the most recent action, sharing the key moments from the previous day as celebrities face jungle life, changing fortunes and challenges ahead together in camp today

programme.title: Prue and Sandi's South African Adventure
programme.desc: [AD] Prue Leith and Sandi Toksvig continue their journey of Prue's beloved homeland. The pair head to Paternoster on South Africa's West Coast, where they explore the shoreline's wildlife and forage for seaweed among the rocks with chef Kobus van der Merwe, whose restaurant has drawn global attention for its local produce. At the harbour, Sandi helps a fisherman with his nets in return for a fresh lobster, before the pair visit salt pans to see how salt flakes are formed using sun and wind

programme.title: Grand Designs
programme.desc: [AD] Entrepreneur Piers and police officer Emma plan to build a landmark 21st-century castle in Stratford-upon-Avon which at 1100 square metres, is the biggest ever build featured on the show. With plans to have a tower, castellations, a moat, arrow slits, loggia courtyards and futuristic technology, it's set to be the first new listed castle in the UK for 100 years

programme.title: A Very M&S Christmas
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of M&S during the festive period as it takes on its toughest rival yet - itself. Chefs and food writers sit down to a Christmas dinner made up of the retailer's products, pitting the premium ranges against the standard versions. Also, following a family who shop around the supermarkets for deals, and there's a look at the flavour combinations the retailer hopes will go viral

programme.title: Forensics: Crash Scene Investigators
programme.desc: In Derbyshire, the team deals with two separate cases involving fatalities, with a 47-year-old man killed by an unhitched 20-ton trailer that toppled onto his vehicle while he was giving his daughter a driving lesson. the other case involves a woman who was hit head-on by an out-of-control driver travelling on the wrong side of country road

programme.title: Rob Beckett: Giraffe
programme.desc: A stand-up show by the comedian at the London Palladium at the end of his global tour, which started in November 2024

programme.title: Caught on Dashcam
programme.desc: Fly-on-the-dashboard documentary showcasing outrageous road disasters, captured in video form by drivers' in-vehicle dashboard cameras

programme.title: The Rookie
programme.desc: [AD] With Elijah and Abril now allies, the team rely on Monica to uncover their plans. Meanwhile, Nolan and Juarez reopens her sister's case

programme.title: Fargo
programme.desc: Minnesota housewife Dorothy 'Dot' Lyon finds herself in a pickle following a misunderstanding at the PTA meeting, which makes for awkward dinner table conversation that evening at her in-laws house, the wealthy Lyon family. As Dot's past comes back to haunt her, the peaceful life with her husband Wayne and daughter, Scottie starts to unravel. Fifth instalment of the crime drama anthology, starring Juno Temple, Jennifer Jason Leigh and David Rysdahl

programme.title: Sweetpea
programme.sub-title: Why Did You Have to Ruin Everything?
programme.desc: [AD] Rhiannon scrambles to cover up what happened to AJ, but Seren and an attentive doctor aren't making things easy. Still reeling from what she's done and haunted by AJ's words, Rhiannon gets a much-needed confidence boost from an unexpected source, reigniting her taste for her darker pursuits, but someone may be watching her. Return of the black comedy drama, starring Ella Purnell

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: [AD] Commissioner Selwyn Patterson struggles in the wake of his shock shooting, and the local community is rocked by a murder at a care home when a game of bingo gets horribly out of hand. But could someone really kill over something so trivial? As the case takes on a series of jaw-dropping twists and turns, Neville and the team realise that this case is so much more than it first appeared on the surface. Hayley Mills guest stars

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: [AD] The Father is in a race against time to prove the innocence of a man currently standing trial for murder. Fifties-set crime drama based on the stories by GK Chesterton

programme.title: dinnerladies
programme.desc: [AD] Twinkle and Stan spoil Petula's plans for a peaceful family Christmas, and a baby is found abandoned near the canteen. Bren's romance with Tony is ruined by the unexpected reappearance of her husband, and Anita goes away - but leaves her inflatable man behind. Festive special from 1999, starring Victoria Wood

programme.title: Knowing Me, Knowing Yule - With Alan Partridge
programme.sub-title: Knowing Me, Knowing Yule - With Alan Partridge
programme.desc: Festive special from 1995. The chat show host throws a seasonal house party, set in an exact replica of his Norwich home. Guests include a cross-dressing celebrity chef, a team of sea cadets trying to pull the world's biggest Christmas cracker, and a professional golfer who was struck by lightning in the closing stages of a major tournament. Appropriately festive music is supplied by a team of bellringers, and the cast includes Steve Coogan, Patrick Marber, Rebecca Front, David Schneider, Doon Mackichan and Kevin Eldon

programme.title: Would I Lie to You?
programme.desc: Team captains David Mitchell and Lee Mack are joined by guest players Rhod Gilbert, Jamie Laing, Tracy-Ann Oberman and Claudia Winkleman, who aim to deceive their opponents with plausible lies. Hosted by Rob Brydon

programme.title: Have I Got a Bit More News for You
programme.desc: Professor Hannah Fry hosts, with guest panellists Rev Richard Coles and comedian Finlay Christie joining team captains Paul Merton and Ian Hislop as they delve into the news

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One with Ross's Inappropriate Song
programme.desc: [AD] Ross makes Emma laugh by singing Baby Got Back, while Joey and Chandler find an incriminating video in Richard's old apartment with a familiar face in a leading role. Phoebe fails to impress her boyfriend's parents, who encourage him to date someone else, forcing him to declare his love for her

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One with Rachel's Other Sister
programme.desc: [AD] Rachel's sister Amy joins the gang for Thanksgiving, and Monica worries about her best china getting damaged. Meanwhile, Joey forgets to turn up for the Days of Our Lives cast float. Guest starring Christina Applegate

programme.title: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
programme.sub-title: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
programme.desc: A velvet-clad, sex-crazed secret agent from the 1960s agrees to be put into a state of suspended animation after his arch-enemy escapes justice. Thirty years later he is defrosted to do battle with the power-mad villain again, but the mission proves nearly as daunting for him as getting to grips with 1990s social values. Spoof spy adventure, with Mike Myers, Elizabeth Hurley, Mimi Rogers, Michael York and Robert Wagner

programme.title: The Office (US)
programme.desc: Following a suggestion from Andy, Michael has the staff work together on sales calls, and discovers a few things about his employees in the process

programme.title: The Office (US)
programme.desc: Oscar's return from his vacation prompts Michael to host a Mexican-themed party, while Michael is distraught over Dwight's resignation and confronts him at Staples.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Undercover cops Schmidt and Jenko are sent on a new assignment at a university. When one joins the college American football team and the other falls in with a crowd of Bohemian artists, loyalty to their new cliques puts a strain on their friendship. Crime comedy, starring Jonah Hill and Channing Tatum

programme.title: Katie Price: Nothing to Hide
programme.desc: [AD] A profile of one of Britain's most enduring celebrity figures, combining previously unseen footage with first-hand testimonies from Katie and those closest to her

programme.title: Katie Price: Nothing to Hide
programme.desc: [AD] As she becomes a mother to Harvey, a secret romance and relentless public scrutiny make Katie public enemy number one, before I'm A Celebrity changes everything

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: [AD] Roman general Maximus Decimus Meridius is a casualty of a power struggle between the corrupt Emperor Commodus and the senate. Ordered to be put to death along with his family, he escapes his would-be killers but is sold into slavery as a gladiator - and uses his fame in the arena to fight against the tyrant. Ridley Scott's Oscar-winning period epic, with Russell Crowe, Joaquin Phoenix, Derek Jacobi and Oliver Reed, in his last film role

programme.title: Wheel of Fortune
programme.desc: [AD] Graham Norton hosts as former airport security official Sheila, housing supervisor Leo and special educational needs teacher Austin compete to solve word puzzles to get the chance to spin the wheel and win big money prizes

programme.title: Family Guy
programme.desc: [AD] After seeing a news report on rising crime in Quahog, the Griffins return home to find they have been robbed. Peter announces they are selling their house and moving to a farm in the countryside, but when they begin to struggle financially, he starts an illicit drug business

programme.title: Family Guy
programme.desc: [AD] Brian wins tickets to a Celine Dion concert in Las Vegas, but as he and Stewie prepare to travel, the tot tries out his new teleportation machine. Stewie believes the machine has not worked, but instead he has accidentally duplicated himself and Brian, with one pair going to the show, and the other transported elsewhere

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: [AD] Following the suicide of Jeanie Long, the woman convicted of the murder of teenager Abigail Mantel 11 years earlier, new evidence comes to light exonerating her. DCI Vera Stanhope reinvestigates the case, but to find out who really killed Abigail, the detective must uncover the secrets of a close-knit community that is still coming to terms with the incident. Detective drama, adapted from Ann Cleeves' novel Telling Tales, guest starring Hugo Speer alongside Brenda Blethyn, David Leon, Wunmi Mosaku and Paul Ritter

programme.title: The Motorbike Show
programme.desc: Henry Cole takes a wild ride through Gran Canaria, and visits the Morgan factory to learn about their iconic three wheelers and what they are like to ride. The presenters also track down a classic chopper to restore

programme.title: Junk & Disorderly
programme.desc: It's new leads and fresh bargains as Henry and Skid scout FM Hutchings, restore their haul and test their luck at Malvern Autojumble

programme.title: Forensics: Catching the Killer
programme.desc: [AD] The documentary tells the story of a man who thought he had got away with his parents' murder - until the chemical compound luminol revealed a trail of his bloody footprints

programme.title: Libby, Are You Home Yet?
programme.desc: [AD] An investigation of the 2019 murder of student Libby Squire, whose disappearance after a night out in Hull sparked the biggest manhunt in Humberside Police history

programme.title: Inside the Music
programme.desc: The London Philharmonic Orchestra takes viewers behind the works of German composer Johannes Brahms, known for his symphonies, concertos, chamber music and Hungarian dances

programme.title: Dangerous Debussy
programme.desc: A look at the life and work of French composer Claude Debussy, told through the relationships with the women who loved, supported and inspired him

programme.title: Shipwrecks: When History Resurfaces
programme.sub-title: Shipwrecked Sailors of the Roman Empire
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Sea witnessed unprecedented maritime traffic. Many ships perished there, while carrying valuable cargo destined to extend the power of Rome. Kevin Sempé dives in search of these wrecks, without which Rome could never have existed.

programme.title: Deep Water Secrets
programme.desc: Exploring the unexplained and the never-before-seen encounters with history's strangest aquatic mysteries, from creatures to natural anomalies to lost cities and monuments. A tracker washes ashore in Australia with no marine mammal in sight, prompting an investigation into what killed a great white shark

programme.title: Shark with Steve Backshall
programme.desc: [AD] The naturalist learns about the sharks of the Indian Ocean, which despite finding ways to adapt to the environment, face threats from climate change, pollution and overfishing

programme.title: Kui Buri: Thailand's Hidden Eden
programme.desc: A look at Kui Buri National Park in Thailand, a hidden eden which is home to Asian elephants and the world's largest bovine - the gaur. Once farmland, it's now a model national park

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour
programme.desc: [AD] Mike Brewer and Elvis Priestley hit the beach for the ultimate surf wagon: the iconic Holden Sandman. Can they transform a drab panel van into a hit budget version?

programme.title: Gold Rush

programme.desc: [AD] With just a few days to go before Stacey and Joe welcome friends and family to the lake, the pressure is on to get everything finished. But before the final push begins, there's an emotional goodbye as Stacey takes Zach to the airport for his journey to America. But back home, Joe cheers her up with an unlikely upcycling project. Family and friends then arrive to see the hard work Joe and Stacey have put into the lake - but the morning after, they pack the car and say goodbye to Pickle Cottage

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: [AD] Knockout week begins, with the 12 remaining chefs facing their toughest test yet as seafood maestro Paul Ainsworth challenges them to reinvent one of Britain's best-loved dishes - fish and chips. But a classic simply won't cut it. Paul wants culinary brilliance, daring innovation and a dish that will blow his mind. Those who perform strongest will secure a place in the semi-finals, while the four worst are forced into a second challenge that turns the rules of cooking on its head. With the hobs and ovens switched off, the contestants must create an exceptional dish using only raw ingredients

programme.title: Disclosure: Why Boys Carry Knives
programme.desc: As knife crime changes on Scotland's streets, this report explores the pressures and influences that can lead young men to pick up a weapon. From victims with life-changing injuries to young people carrying knives to feel safe, and boys behind bars, Disclosure hears from those whose lives have been shaped by knife crime. In a world where social media can fuel conflict and amplify reputations, the programme asks what is driving this trend, and what it will take to stop it

programme.title: Back in the Day
programme.desc: Famous Welsh faces and their family members take a trip down memory lane to remember what people used to do to look and feel good. Contributors include Max Boyce, Bronwen Lewis, Mike Bubbins, Sam Warburton, Owen Money, Colin Jackson, Kiri Pritchard-McLean, Melanie Walters, Eleri Sion, Scott Quinnell, Steve Speirs, Ian 'H' Watkins and Owain Wyn Evans

programme.sub-title: Lost on the Cape Wrath Trail
programme.desc: [AD] Police mountain rescue officers search for a 76-year-old walker who has been missing for days during terrible weather in one of the Highlands' most remote areas. In Stornoway, officers try to calm a dispute between relatives exchanging violent threats, while police in Nairn deal with a bust-up on a bus that threatens to turn violent

programme.title: QI XL
programme.desc: Sandi Toksvig hosts and extended version of the quiz, looking for the X factor with Kiri Pritchard-McLean, Daniel Sloss, La Voix and Alan Davies

programme.title: Crá
programme.desc: Sabine's funeral takes place and her son, Conall, and her husband, Art, are the main murder suspects. Ciara-Kate is convinced that Sabine was having an affair and decides to investigate. Conall is determined to get to the truth about his father's involvement in his mother's death but is rocked when a ghost from his past returns. In Irish

programme.title: BBC News at Ten
programme.desc: A round-up of today's headlines

programme.title: BBC London News; Weather
programme.desc: The latest updates from the region

programme.title: Tall Tales & Murder
programme.desc: [AD] Bridget and Paul try to raise money for guns as Grinner goes on a mammoth drinking session with underworld fixer and horse Viagra bootlegger Chick. Ma Baker is on the prowl

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events, presented by Victoria Derbyshire

programme.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather
programme.desc: A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: [AD] At Queen's Medical Centre in Nottingham, a 23-year-old woman has had a riding accident, falling off her horse which then rolled on top of her. Doctors urgently need to determine if a 26-year-old man is having a stroke. And a five-year-old boy is brought into A&E after badly cutting his hand at school

programme.title: The Basement: A Vanishing In Apple Valley
programme.desc: A two-part documentary about the abduction of single mother Tina Herrmann, her two children and a neighbour in the sleepy Ohio town of Apple Valley in 2010. The amount of blood in at the scene told police they were facing a race against time, and the discovery of a receipt, duct tape and rope led them to local tree surgeon Matthew Hoffman. The police seemed to think he had been expecting them - but did he know where Tina and the others were?

programme.title: Karl Pilkington: The Moaning of Life
programme.desc: [AD] Karl investigates how people should spend their limited time on the planet as he finds out what he will be like as an old man

programme.title: FBI: Most Wanted
programme.desc: [AD] The team races against the clock to track down a young anti-government terrorist before he can exact revenge on those he believes failed him

programme.title: Accidentally Famous: The Story of 883
programme.desc: Cisco struggles with debts at the Jolly Blue arcade, and the band weighs up whether or not to attend a New Year's Eve party held in their honour. In Italian

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: [AD] Murder proves to be no laughing matter when Father Brown visits a jesters' convention. Whodunit, starring Mark Williams as the sleuthing priest, with Neil Pearson and Paul Copley

programme.title: The Fast Show: Christmas Special
programme.desc: Festive edition of the comedy sketch show from 1996, with characters joining in the fun including the Suit You tailors, Ron Manager, Ted and Ralph, Competitive Dad, Colin Hunt, Rowley Birkin QC and Jesse. Meanwhile. Jazz Club puts a new spin on We Wish You a Merry Christmas. Starring Paul Whitehouse, Charlie Higson, Caroline Aherne, Mark Williams, John Thomson, Arabella Weir and Simon Day

programme.title: QI XL
programme.desc: Extended edition. Question master Stephen Fry continues the comedy panel quiz's exploration of subjects beginning with the letter L as he asks a range of fiendish questions on the topics of love and loveliness. Joining regular panellist Alan Davies are stand-up and The Last Leg co-host Josh Widdicombe, Irish actress and comedienne Aisling Bea and author and comedian Tony Hawks

programme.title: Katie Price: Nothing to Hide
programme.desc: [AD] As Katie and Peter Andre become a celebrity power couple, a carefully orchestrated rebrand kills off Jordan, threatening her identity, relationship and future

programme.title: Inside Chernobyl's Mega Tomb
programme.desc: [AD] Documentary following the construction of a 36,000 tonne steel structure to entomb the ruins of the nuclear power plant destroyed in the 1986 disaster. A team of international engineers race to build the new steel structure, but radiation levels make it almost impossible for workers to build right on top of the old reactor. The team face difficult challenges as they attempt to erect this new steel mega-structure and move it into place

programme.title: The Stand Up Sketch Show
programme.desc: A stand-up and sketch comedy show, this time featuring Seann Walsh, Red Richardson, Catherine Bohart, Bobby Mair, Huge Davies, Tadiwa Mahlunge, Sharon Wanjohi and Ian Smith

programme.title: I'm a Celebrity... Unpacked
programme.desc: Sam Thompson and Kemi Rodgers host the companion show, featuring behind-the-scenes gossip, unseen clips, interviews and an insider guide to the trials

programme.title: Foyle's War
programme.desc: [AD] The detective's god-daughter Lydia and her son James - who is severely traumatised by a bombing at his school - come to stay unexpectedly. Struggling to look after the lad when his mother goes missing, Foyle's life suffers a further complication when the body of a local man is found near a military centre - leading him into the top-secret world of weapons research. Kate Fleetwood and Michael Jayston guest star, with Michael Kitchen and Honeysuckle Weeks

programme.title: All Elite Wrestling: Collision
programme.desc: Hard-hitting action, featuring stars including FTR, Thunder Rosa, Jon Moxley and Jay White. With high-flying, hard-hitting, over-the-top action from some of the best wrestlers on the planet. Tony Schiavone and Nigel McGuinness present

programme.title: Libby, Are You Home Yet?
programme.desc: [AD] The police find evidence of Libby Squire entering an unknown vehicle and when an arrest is made, investigators receive calls pointing to a possible stalker

programme.title: Stories from the National Gallery
programme.desc: Part one of two. To mark the 200th anniversary of the art museum, Kate Bryan explores the stories behind key artworks in the gallery's collection

programme.title: Monster Aliens
programme.desc: Investigating monster tales told throughout history and whether the explanation could be extraterrestrial. Beginning with Bigfoot

programme.title: David Attenborough's Wild City
programme.desc: [AD] The veteran broadcaster narrates a day in the animal life of Singapore's urban environments, from a troop of suburban macaques to a family of otters in Marina Bay

programme.title: Gold Rush: Winter's Fortune
programme.desc: Rick resurrects Monster Red to capture nuggets with help from Freddy Dodge. Tony builds a huge excavator, while Dustin returns to Haines after a devastating landslide

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach
programme.desc: Intimate dates cause a battle for Freddie's affection, and the first ex crash lands into the villa threatening one couple's connection

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: [AD] Ross is unsure whether to start a romance with Rachel, so he draws up a list of her good and bad points, then looks on in horror as she accidentally sees the offending document. Comedy, starring David Schwimmer and Jennifer Aniston

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: [AD] Rachel meets a man called Russ who bears an uncanny resemblance to Ross, further confusing her already muddled emotions. Meanwhile, Joey discovers he will have to pass an intimate audition on the casting couch to get a part in a daytime soap

programme.title: Cause of Death
programme.desc: Investigating the death of 17-year-old Derbyshire boxer Ed Bilbey, who collapsed nine minutes into a fight for the 2017 East Midlands amateur youth welterweight title. Despite the efforts of paramedics and hospital staff, he was pronounced dead later that evening. Forensic Pathologist Dr Richard Shepherd sets out to explain what could have led to Ed's death

programme.title: Secret Nazi Science
programme.desc: [AD] Exploring a history of groundbreaking ordnance, from a guided anti-ship gliding bomb to the world's first precision-guided weapon deployed during combat

programme.title: The Celebrity Chase
programme.desc: TV presenter Fern Britton, former England cricketer Matthew Hoggard, lingerie tycoon Michelle Mone and actor Neil Morrissey pit their general knowledge against a trivia expert as they try to win thousands of pounds for charity. However, they must work as a team to build their prize pot and stay one step ahead of the Chaser. Bradley Walsh hosts

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: Game show, hosted by Ben Shephard, in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: As the night shift begins, 82 patients across the North West are waiting for an ambulance with a new call being taken every 30 seconds. Advanced Paramedic Amy is dispatched to reports of a man lying face down in the middle of the road while Cameron and Kiera respond to a nine-year-old with a bowel blockage. Debbie, Kelsea and Senior Paramedic Debbie are dispatched to a 40-year-old male who is unconscious, not breathing and bleeding from the head and a GP calls with concerns about her diabetic patient with abdominal pain

programme.title: Sister Wives
programme.desc: Christine, Janelle, and Meri get together for the first time in years, which brings up old wounds and leaves Meri wanting a deeper conversation.

programme.title: Pel-Droed Rhyngwladol
programme.desc: Wales v Norway. Action from the first leg of the FIFA Women's World Cup play-off final, held at Cardiff City Stadium

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: [AD] The armchair critics share their opinions on what they have been watching during the week, with cameras capturing their instant reactions to the Eurovision Song Contest, Bridgerton, Love Triangle Australia, Double the Money, Marcus Wareing Simply Provence, Narrow Escapes and news coverage of the Northern Lights being visible in British skies

programme.title: Emergency Helicopter Medics
programme.desc: [AD] Air ambulance crews respond to headteacher Andy who has collapsed after a cardiac arrest in Essex and warehouse employee Rob who is trapped under a pallet of granite in Ipswich. Katie, who is 13-weeks pregnant, calls for help when she keeps having seizures and the Essex and Herts Air Ambulance crew help Jo who has been lying on the bathroom floor with a broken ankle for nine hours

programme.title: Top Guns: Inside the RAF
programme.desc: Behind the scenes with the RAF around the world, as tensions rise in the Middle East and British forces are on high alert to counter the growing threat from Russia. In the Arctic Circle, RAF troops learn to fight in sub-zero temperatures, while in the Nevada desert, Typhoon pilots join the world's biggest aerial wargame

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Sean Lock and Harriet Kemsley take on special guest team captain Alan Carr and Catherine Tate in the words-and-numbers quiz, while Adam Buxton joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner. Hosted by Jimmy Carr, with regular Countdown mathematician Rachel Riley looking after the numbers and letters

programme.title: Murder at the Motel
programme.desc: Investigators trace a crime to Room 15 of the Sportsman's Lodge Motel, where blood evidence and a palm print reveal a violent struggle

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Experts restore a tarnished rugby trophy, a hand-operated Victorian sewing machine, and a 1930s accordion, which has 64 individual components in need of repair

programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
programme.desc: The decomposing body of a five-year-old girl is found, leading to the revelation that a homicidal paedophile is on the loose. The subsequent disappearance of a second youngster leads to a race against time to save her from a similar fate. Gritty drama, starring Christopher Meloni, Mariska Hargitay and Dann Florek

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell return to tell incredible stories of people desperate to find missing family and answer questions that have haunted entire lives. This week features two stories of children searching for their birth mothers after life-changing events - former Scotland footballer Dominic Matteo, who started to search after suffering a life-threatening brain tumour, and a woman, pained with emotion on her wedding day because her birth mother was missing

programme.title: New Tricks
programme.desc: [AD] The team reopens a case originally worked on by a corrupt colleague of Sandra's father, leading the detective to seek the truth about her family's shady past - a decision that puts pressure on the relationship with her mother. Brian investigates a suspicious death at a brewery, while Gerry and Jack take the time to sample its wares

programme.title: Home Comforts at Christmas
programme.desc: [AD] James Martin demonstrates festive food for inexperienced cooks, including puddings, Christmas Eve suppers and main course dishes. With Helen Skelton

programme.title: Wynonna Earp
programme.desc: Curse originator Bulshar has come out from the shadows, and Wynonna and the team must deal with the fallout with help from an entity claiming to be from Black Badge Division

programme.title: Murder UK
programme.desc: The case of Katie Wilding, who sought romance but found abuse. Her death was ruled as an overdose, but her family wanted justice.

programme.title: Judge Judy
programme.desc: A 19-year-old tenant is accused of corrupting her landlord's teenage daughter by allegedly offering her ecstasy and alcohol.

programme.title: Judge Judy
programme.desc: A holiday is ruined when lovers call it quits and one party refuses to move out of their shared apartment.

programme.title: Judge Judy
programme.desc: Neighbours fighting about the border between their homes get into a standoff over a fence and the removal of contested trees.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: [AD] Police fight to stop a stolen truck with a hostage inside, and a domestic call turns deadly when the suspect shoots at officers at point-blank range

programme.title: The Rumour
programme.desc: [AD] Joanna is blindsided when a reporter questions her about the chilling rumour - someone has fed him information. Bea urges her to drop it, but threats force Joanna and Alfie to stay with her. Then she discovers Michael has picked up Alfie from school without her knowledge. Panic consumes her as she frantically searches, fearing the worst. As the press exposes Sonia, tensions explode. On Halloween, the kids enter her house after finding the door open - and inside, they make a shocking discovery

programme.title: Law & Order: Criminal Intent
programme.desc: Goren and Eames investigate the contract killing of a businessman's wife. Evidence at the scene points to two assailants, one of whom was wearing a bandage, and the victim's mother-in-law becomes the chief suspect. Starring Vincent D'Onofrio, Kathryn Erbe and Jamey Sheridan

programme.title: Murder Suspect No 1
programme.desc: A man is brutally beaten with a suspected knuckle duster in his own home in Hull and later dies in hospital, launching an intense and urgent murder inquiry. A young woman who called the ambulance is arrested - but is she responsible or a crucial witness?

programme.title: Evil Lives Here
programme.desc: When Teresa claims her seven-year-old daughter has a terminal illness, the community rallies around them. Then, the shocking truth is revealed

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: [AD] Derek picks up a rare Ford Zodiac Farnham Estate, while Dave heads for an isolated tent in the Midlands to collect a Triumph Toledo

programme.title: Weird Britain
programme.desc: Andy McGrath and comedian Billy Kirkwood dive into some of Scotland's quirkiest urban legends and hoaxes, such as the infamous Wild Haggis and the Gorbals Vampire

programme.title: Street Outlaws: Farmtruck And AZN
programme.desc: Farmtruck and AZN get nautical when the team creates a Farmboat to keep up with the speediest boats on the water. But staying afloat proves tricky.

programme.title: Treasure Hunters Down Under
programme.desc: A diverse group of detectorists scour Australia for lost coins, historical artefacts and gold. In Sydney, Michael and Max take the plunge for sunken treasures

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How a set of jaws are forged, capable of chomping through concrete and demolish tower blocks. Plus, the ways an historic airman's bomber jacket can be stiched, and the means of brewing the oldest beer in the Western world

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: The complex technological processes involved in cooling the iconic Sydney Opera House. Plus, an insight into how Sheffield steel is transformed into a carpenter's handsaw, and the production of a microphone capable of picking up a whisper

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: [AD] A hungry bear breaks into Noah's tent and terrifies the livestock. Later, the windmill assembly takes the siblings to dangerous new heights

programme.title: Deep Water Secrets
programme.desc: Exploring the unexplained and the never-before-seen encounters with history's strangest aquatic mysteries, from creatures to natural anomalies to lost cities and monuments. A tracker washes ashore in Australia with no marine mammal in sight, prompting an investigation into what killed a great white shark

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Exploring Brazil's dangerous serpents, including an endangered species found on one small island. Plus, a look at the science behind the life-saving anti-venom treatments

programme.title: Secrets of the London Underground
programme.desc: [AD] Tim Dunn and Siddy Holloway explore the abandoned branch line between Holborn and Aldwych, and at Holloway Road they find out about the Tube's only spiral escalator

Fantasy drama, starring Michael Keaton, Kelly Preston, Joseph Cross and Mark Addy

programme.title: Nativity!
programme.desc: A primary school teacher is given the job of directing a nativity play and is determined to outdo a rival from a nearby private school. Comedy, starring Martin Freeman and Ashley Jensen

programme.title: Nativity 2: Danger in the Manger!
programme.desc: A primary school teacher enters his class in a Song for Christmas competition, and ends up having to lead the busload of excitable kids - as well as his irresponsible teaching assistant - on a disastrous trip to Wales for the event. The journey also leads to an unwanted confrontation with his high-flying twin brother. Comedy sequel, starring David Tennant, Marc Wootton, Joanna Page and Jessica Hynes

programme.title: Nativity 3: Dude, Where's My Donkey?!
programme.desc: The pupils of St Bernadette's face a new challenge as Christmas approaches, when their new teacher loses his memory, forgetting everything about the festive season and that he is about to get married. It falls to the kids, led by excitable teacher Mr Poppy, to help him remember both in time for the wedding. Comedy sequel, starring Martin Clunes, Catherine Tate, Marc Wootton and Celia Imrie

programme.title: Open Season 3
programme.desc: Boog the bear visits a Russian travelling circus, where he meets another bear named Doug who is his exact double. Doug suggests they swap places for the day, but when the time comes to go back to their old lives, Doug is nowhere to be found, leaving Boog trapped. Animated adventure, with the voices of Matthew J Munn and Matthew W Taylor

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: [AD] Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson

programme.title: Chicken Run
programme.desc: A headstrong chicken and her fellow fowls ponder how to escape from a grim Yorkshire farm before the evil farmer's wife can turn them into pies. Luckily, help arrives in the form of a heroic American rooster who promises to show them how to fly. Nick Park's animated comedy, with the voices of Mel Gibson, Julia Sawalha, Miranda Richardson and Jane Horrocks

programme.title: Antz
programme.desc: A neurotic worker ant passes himself off as a soldier to impress a princess. However, he provokes a jealously ambitious general with an accidental act of heroism - so he and his beloved decide to flee the brutal colony and go in search of the promised land of Insectopia. Animated comedy, with the voices of Woody Allen, Sharon Stone, Gene Hackman and Sylvester Stallone

programme.title: Monster Trucks
programme.desc: [AD] A drilling operation unleashes a subterranean creature which feeds on oil. The monster bonds with a monster truck which a local teenager is building from spare parts, and the youngster befriends the beast and helps it to return to its underground home. Fantasy adventure, starring Lucas Till and Jane Levy

programme.title: Peter Pan
programme.desc: The adventures of the boy who never grows old, as he whisks Wendy Darling and her brothers away to the magical world of Neverland - where they come face to face with fearsome Captain Hook. Adaptation of JM Barrie's fantasy novel, starring Jeremy Sumpter, Rachel Hurd-Wood, Jason Isaacs and Lynn Redgrave

programme.title: Shazam!

Together with his best friend Freddy Freeman, Billy must come to terms with his new talents in order to stop the evil Dr Thaddeus Sivana. Comedy adventure based on the Captain Marvel and Shazam comics, starring Zachary Levi, Mark Strong and Asher Angel

programme.title: Tarzan
programme.desc: A man raised by gorillas in the jungle has his first encounter with humans in the form of a scientist and his daughter, and is torn between remaining among the apes or rediscovering his roots. He must also fight to defend his animal friends from a big-game hunter. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tony Goldwyn and Minnie Driver

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois

programme.title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas
programme.sub-title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas
programme.desc: Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King of Halloween Town, tires of being scary and decides to take over the friendly world of Christmas. After kidnapping Santa, he prepares to take his place and do Christmas in his own ghoulish way. Stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Chris Sarandon, Catherine O'Hara and Paul Reubens, and a musical score by Danny Elfman

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: A secret service operative is reassigned from Presidential Protection after a tragic accident. As he prepares to leave his assignment, terrorists take control of the White House and hold the president hostage. The agent is trapped in the building, and uses his inside knowledge to rescue the head of state. Action thriller, starring Gerard Butler, Aaron Eckhart and Morgan Freeman

Thriller, starring Samuel L Jackson, Julianna Margulies and Jonathan Phillips

programme.sub-title: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
programme.desc: An American teenager is sent to live with his father in Tokyo after a brush with the law, but soon becomes involved in illegal street racing. When he ends up owing money to gangsters after losing a race against a driver with Yakuza connections, he has to learn to master the Japanese style of driving to win and pay back his debts. Action adventure, starring Lucas Black, Nathalie Kelley and Bow Wow

Crime thriller inspired by the 1969 movie, starring Mark Wahlberg, Charlize Theron, Edward Norton, Seth Green and Donald Sutherland

Comedy inspired by the 1980s TV series, with Jonah Hill and Channing Tatum

Crime comedy, starring Jonah Hill and Channing Tatum

Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.sub-title: Fly-Tippers Get Caught in the Act
programme.desc: In Warwickshire, farmers take a stand against fly-tippers who have been blighting their land with van loads of dumped waste. Presented by Steph McGovern

Psychological thriller, starring Solly McLeod, Robyn Malcolm and Richard Roxburgh

programme.title: First Dates
programme.desc: [AD] Fred Sirieix throws open the restaurant doors to more singletons. programme.title: Without Remorse

programme.title: CIA

programme.title: FBI: International

programme.title: Mulholland Drive

David Lynch's mystery, starring Naomi Watts, Justin Theroux, Laura Harring and Robert Forster

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: [AD] A body is discovered floating in the pool of an exclusive cosmetic surgery clinic and several things point to suicide - the victim was going through a messy divorce and there is an empty pill box in her room. But DI Poole has several reasons to believe Valerie Dupree was murdered - not least the fact she poured herself a cup of the world's most expensive tea but only drank half. The pressure is on to find the culprit as the clinic is highly respected on the island and the chief surgeon is an old friend of Commissioner Patterson - and as the detectives begin to dig, they discover many sordid secrets among the guests and staff. Cherie Lunghi (Secret Diary of a Call Girl), James Fleet (The Vicar of Dibley) and Emma Pierson (Hotel Babylon) guest star

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: [AD] Crime drama about a British detective working on a Caribbean island. There are numerous suspects, including the victim's alcoholic ex-wife and much younger widow, but they all have seemingly cast-iron alibis - and many were with one another when the murder took place. Crime drama, starring Ben Miller, with guest appearances by Stephanie Beacham (Dynasty, Tenko), James Cosmo (Game of Thrones) and Tom Ward (Silent Witness)
